name: What is the process for installing an ADU bathroom from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing an ADU bathroom from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing an ADU bathroom generally begins with planning and design, followed by obtaining necessary permits. Next comes rough-in plumbing and electrical work, framing, insulation, and then drywall installation. After that, finishes like flooring, tile, cabinetry, and fixture installation are completed. A First-Party Insight is that Hometelligent Inc. always prioritizes detailed planning sessions to align with client expectations and streamline the subsequent construction phases, ensuring a smoother transition from design to completion. Final inspections are conducted before the bathroom is ready for use.
acceptedAnswer.description: The ADU bathroom installation process includes planning, permits, rough-in work, framing, drywall, and finishing. Hometelligent Inc. emphasizes detailed planning to align with client expectations and smooth construction.
